    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, user-scalable=yes" />
    <title>ShellCheck: SC1039 – Remove indentation before end token (or use `<<-` and indent with tabs).</title>
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="css/bootstrap.min.css" />
  </head>
  <body style="margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto; max-width: 800px">
    <h1>SC1039 – ShellCheck Wiki</h1>
    <a href="https://github.com/koalaman/shellcheck/wiki/SC1039">See this page on GitHub</a>
    <p style="display: none"><a href="index.html">Sitemap</a></p>
    <hr />
    <h2
id="remove-indentation-before-end-token-or-use---and-indent-with-tabs">Remove
indentation before end token (or use <code>&lt;&lt;-</code> and indent
with tabs).</h2>
<h3 id="problematic-code">Problematic code:</h3>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb1"><pre class="sourceCode sh"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb1-1"><a href="#cb1-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">for</span> f <span class="kw">in</span> <span class="pp">*</span>.png</span>
<span id="cb1-2"><a href="#cb1-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">do</span></span>
<span id="cb1-3"><a href="#cb1-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="fu">cat</span> <span class="op">&lt;&lt; HTML</span></span>
<span id="cb1-4"><a href="#cb1-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="st">     &lt;img src=&quot;</span><span class="va">$f</span><span class="st">&quot; /&gt;&lt;br/&gt;</span></span>
<span id="cb1-5"><a href="#cb1-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="st">  HTML</span></span>
<span id="cb1-6"><a href="#cb1-6" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="st">done &gt; index.html</span></span></code></pre></div>
<h3 id="correct-code">Correct code:</h3>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb2"><pre class="sourceCode sh"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb2-1"><a href="#cb2-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">for</span> f <span class="kw">in</span> <span class="pp">*</span>.png</span>
<span id="cb2-2"><a href="#cb2-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">do</span></span>
<span id="cb2-3"><a href="#cb2-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="fu">cat</span> <span class="op">&lt;&lt; HTML</span></span>
<span id="cb2-4"><a href="#cb2-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="st">     &lt;img src=&quot;</span><span class="va">$f</span><span class="st">&quot; /&gt;&lt;br/&gt;</span></span>
<span id="cb2-5"><a href="#cb2-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="op">HTML</span></span>
<span id="cb2-6"><a href="#cb2-6" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">done</span> <span class="op">&gt;</span> index.html</span></code></pre></div>
<h3 id="rationale">Rationale:</h3>
<p>The here document delimiter will not be recognized if it is
indented.</p>
<p>You can fix it in one of two ways:</p>
<ol>
<li>Simply remove the indentation, even though this may break
formatting.</li>
<li>Use <code>&lt;&lt;-</code> instead of <code>&lt;&lt;</code>, and
indent the script with tabs only (spaces will not be recognized).</li>
</ol>
<p>Removing the indentation is preferred, since the script won't
suddenly break if it's reformatted, copy-pasted, or saved with a
different editor.</p>
<h3 id="exceptions">Exceptions:</h3>
<p>If the line was supposed to be a literal part of the here document,
consider choosing a less ambiguous token.</p>
    <hr />
    <p style='font-size: 80%'><a href="https://www.shellcheck.net">ShellCheck</a> is a static analysis tool for shell scripts. This page is part of its documentation.</p>

    <title>ShellCheck: SC1040 – When using `<<-`, you can only indent with tabs.</title>
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="css/bootstrap.min.css" />
  </head>
  <body style="margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto; max-width: 800px">
    <h1>SC1040 – ShellCheck Wiki</h1>
    <a href="https://github.com/koalaman/shellcheck/wiki/SC1040">See this page on GitHub</a>
    <p style="display: none"><a href="index.html">Sitemap</a></p>
    <hr />
    <h2 id="when-using---you-can-only-indent-with-tabs">When using
<code>&lt;&lt;-</code>, you can only indent with tabs.</h2>
<h3 id="problematic-code">Problematic code:</h3>
<p>Any code using <code>&lt;&lt;-</code> that is indented with spaces.
<code>cat -T script</code> shows</p>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb1"><pre class="sourceCode sh"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb1-1"><a href="#cb1-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="fu">cat</span> <span class="op">&lt;&lt;- foo</span></span>
<span id="cb1-2"><a href="#cb1-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="st">        Hello world</span></span>
<span id="cb1-3"><a href="#cb1-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="st">    foo</span></span></code></pre></div>
<h3 id="correct-code">Correct code:</h3>
<p>Code using <code>&lt;&lt;-</code> must be indented with tabs.
<code>cat -T script</code> shows</p>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb2"><pre class="sourceCode sh"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb2-1"><a href="#cb2-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">^Icat</span> <span class="op">&lt;&lt;- foo</span></span>
<span id="cb2-2"><a href="#cb2-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="st">^I^IHello world</span></span>
<span id="cb2-3"><a href="#cb2-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="st">^Ifoo</span></span></code></pre></div>
<p>Or simply don't indent the end token:</p>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb3"><pre class="sourceCode sh"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb3-1"><a href="#cb3-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="fu">cat</span> <span class="op">&lt;&lt;- foo</span></span>
<span id="cb3-2"><a href="#cb3-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="st">      Hello World</span></span>
<span id="cb3-3"><a href="#cb3-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="op">foo</span></span></code></pre></div>
<h3 id="rationale">Rationale:</h3>
<p><code>&lt;&lt;-</code>, by design, only strips tabs. Not spaces.</p>
<p>Your editor may be automatically replacing tabs with spaces, either
when you type them or when you save the file or both. If you're unable
to make it stop, just don't indent the end token.</p>
<h3 id="exceptions">Exceptions</h3>
<p>None. But note that copy-pasting code to <a
href="http://www.shellcheck.net">shellcheck.net</a> may also turn
correct tabs into spaces on some OS.</p>
    <hr />
    <p style='font-size: 80%'><a href="https://www.shellcheck.net">ShellCheck</a> is a static analysis tool for shell scripts. This page is part of its documentation.</p>
  </body>

    <title>ShellCheck: SC1041 – Found `eof` further down, but not on a separate line.</title>
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="css/bootstrap.min.css" />
  </head>
  <body style="margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto; max-width: 800px">
    <h1>SC1041 – ShellCheck Wiki</h1>
    <a href="https://github.com/koalaman/shellcheck/wiki/SC1041">See this page on GitHub</a>
    <p style="display: none"><a href="index.html">Sitemap</a></p>
    <hr />
    <h2 id="found-eof-further-down-but-not-on-a-separate-line">Found
<code>eof</code> further down, but not on a separate line.</h2>
<pre><code>Close matches include &#39;-eof&#39; (!= &#39;eof&#39;).</code></pre>
<h3 id="problematic-code">Problematic code:</h3>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb2"><pre class="sourceCode sh"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb2-1"><a href="#cb2-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">cat</span> <span class="op">&lt;&lt;-eof</span></span>
<span id="cb2-2"><a href="#cb2-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="st">Hello World</span></span>
<span id="cb2-3"><a href="#cb2-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="st">-eof</span></span></code></pre></div>
<h3 id="correct-code">Correct code:</h3>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb3"><pre class="sourceCode sh"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb3-1"><a href="#cb3-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">cat</span> <span class="op">&lt;&lt;- eof</span></span>
<span id="cb3-2"><a href="#cb3-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="st">Hello World</span></span>
<span id="cb3-3"><a href="#cb3-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="op">eof</span></span></code></pre></div>
<h3 id="rationale">Rationale:</h3>
<p>Your here document isn't properly terminated.</p>
<p>There is a line containing the terminator you've chosen, but it's not
by itself on a separate line.</p>
<p>In the example code, the script uses <code>&lt;&lt;-eof</code>, which
is the operator <code>&lt;&lt;-</code> followed by <code>eof</code>. The
script therefore looks for <code>eof</code> and skips right past the
intended terminator because it starts with a dash.</p>
<p>You will get some companion <a href="SC1042">SC1042</a> errors
mentioning lines that contain the string as a substring, though they all
point to the start of the here document and not the relevant line:</p>
<pre><code>In foo line 4:
Hello
^-- SC1041: Found &#39;eof&#39; further down, but not on a separate line.
^-- SC1042: Close matches include &#39;-eof&#39; (!= &#39;eof&#39;).</code></pre>
<p>Look at your here document and see which line was supposed to
terminate it. Then ensure it matches the token exactly, and that it's on
its own line with no text before or after.</p>
<p>Under Windows the error might occur due to the standard CRLF
line-ending, which is Windows-specific. Try to change the line ending
into LF.</p>
<h3 id="exceptions">Exceptions:</h3>
<p>None.</p>
<hr />
<p>Note that SC1041 and <a href="SC1042">SC1042</a> swapped numbers
after v0.4.6 to improve the display order. This rare instance of number
reuse was justified by them always occurring together on the same
line.</p>
    <hr />
    <p style='font-size: 80%'><a href="https://www.shellcheck.net">ShellCheck</a> is a static analysis tool for shell scripts. This page is part of its documentation.</p>
  </body>

    <h2 id="found-eof-further-down-but-with-wrong-casing">Found EOF further
down, but with wrong casing.</h2>
<h3 id="problematic-code">Problematic code:</h3>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb1"><pre class="sourceCode sh"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb1-1"><a href="#cb1-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">cat</span> <span class="op">&lt;&lt; EOF</span></span>
<span id="cb1-2"><a href="#cb1-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="st">Hello World</span></span>
<span id="cb1-3"><a href="#cb1-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="st">Eof</span></span></code></pre></div>
<h3 id="correct-code">Correct code:</h3>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb2"><pre class="sourceCode sh"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb2-1"><a href="#cb2-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">cat</span> <span class="op">&lt;&lt; EOF</span></span>
<span id="cb2-2"><a href="#cb2-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="st">Hello World</span></span>

sure the case matches.</p>
<h3 id="exceptions">Exceptions:</h3>

    <h1>SC1044 – ShellCheck Wiki</h1>
    <a href="https://github.com/koalaman/shellcheck/wiki/SC1044">See this page on GitHub</a>

    <hr />
    <h2 id="couldnt-find-end-token-eof-in-the-here-document">Couldn't find
end token <code>EOF</code> in the here document.</h2>
<h3 id="problematic-code">Problematic code:</h3>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb1"><pre class="sourceCode sh"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb1-1"><a href="#cb1-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">cat</span> <span class="op">&lt;&lt; EOF</span></span>
<span id="cb1-2"><a href="#cb1-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="st">  Hello World</span></span></code></pre></div>
<h3 id="correct-code">Correct code:</h3>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb2"><pre class="sourceCode sh"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb2-1"><a href="#cb2-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">cat</span> <span class="op">&lt;&lt; EOF</span></span>
<span id="cb2-2"><a href="#cb2-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="st">  Hello World</span></span>
<span id="cb2-3"><a href="#cb2-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="op">EOF</span></span></code></pre></div>
<h3 id="rationale">Rationale:</h3>
<p>The <code>&lt;&lt;</code> here document (aka heredoc) was not
properly terminated. The terminating token needs to be on a separate
line without indenting (or indented with tabs only when using
<code>&lt;&lt;-</code>).</p>
<p>Note that you can not put here documents in one liners. For such use
cases, use a <code>&lt;&lt;&lt;</code> here string:</p>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb3"><pre class="sourceCode sh"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb3-1"><a href="#cb3-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">cat</span> <span class="op">&lt;&lt; EOF</span>  hello world  EOF   <span class="st"># Wrong: data and terminator can not be on the same line</span></span>
<span id="cb3-2"><a href="#cb3-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="st">cat &lt;&lt;&lt; &quot;hello world&quot;          # Correct</span></span></code></pre></div>
<h3 id="exceptions">Exceptions:</h3>
<p>None</p>
<h3 id="related-resources">Related resources:</h3>
<ul>
<li>Help by adding links to BashFAQ, StackOverflow, man pages, POSIX,
etc!</li>
</ul>

    <hr />
    <h1 id="its-not-foo--bar-just-foo--bar">It's not
<code>foo &amp;; bar</code>, just <code>foo &amp; bar</code>.</h1>
<h3 id="problematic-code">Problematic code:</h3>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb1"><pre class="sourceCode sh"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb1-1"><a href="#cb1-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">foo</span> <span class="kw">&amp;;</span> <span class="ex">bar</span></span></code></pre></div>
<h3 id="correct-code">Correct code:</h3>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb2"><pre class="sourceCode sh"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb2-1"><a href="#cb2-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">foo</span> <span class="kw">&amp;</span> <span class="ex">bar</span></span></code></pre></div>
<h3 id="rationale">Rationale:</h3>
<p>Both <code>&amp;</code> and <code>;</code> terminate the command. You
should only use one of them.</p>
<h3 id="exceptions">Exceptions</h3>
<p>None.</p>
    <hr />
    <p style='font-size: 80%'><a href="https://www.shellcheck.net">ShellCheck</a> is a static analysis tool for shell scripts. This page is part of its documentation.</p>

    <title>ShellCheck: SC1046 – Couldn't find `fi` for this `if`.</title>
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="css/bootstrap.min.css" />

  <body style="margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto; max-width: 800px">
    <h1>SC1046 – ShellCheck Wiki</h1>
    <a href="https://github.com/koalaman/shellcheck/wiki/SC1046">See this page on GitHub</a>
    <p style="display: none"><a href="index.html">Sitemap</a></p>
    <hr />
    <h2 id="couldnt-find-fi-for-this-if">Couldn't find <code>fi</code> for
this <code>if</code>.</h2>
<h3 id="problematic-code">Problematic code:</h3>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb1"><pre class="sourceCode sh"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb1-1"><a href="#cb1-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">if</span> <span class="fu">true</span></span>
<span id="cb1-2"><a href="#cb1-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">then</span></span>
<span id="cb1-3"><a href="#cb1-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="bu">echo</span> <span class="st">&quot;True&quot;</span></span>
<span id="cb1-4"><a href="#cb1-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">done</span></span></code></pre></div>
<h3 id="correct-code">Correct code:</h3>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb2"><pre class="sourceCode sh"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb2-1"><a href="#cb2-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">if</span> <span class="fu">true</span></span>
<span id="cb2-2"><a href="#cb2-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">then</span></span>
<span id="cb2-3"><a href="#cb2-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="bu">echo</span> <span class="st">&quot;True&quot;</span></span>
<span id="cb2-4"><a href="#cb2-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">fi</span></span></code></pre></div>
<h3 id="rationale">Rationale:</h3>
<p>ShellCheck has found an <code>if</code> statement that does not
appear to have a matching terminating <code>fi</code>.</p>
<p>This could be because it's missing entirely, or because the
<code>if</code> statement was incorrectly terminated by a mismatched
<code>done</code>, <code>esac</code>, <code>)</code> or similar. A
companion warning <a href="SC1047">SC1047</a> is emitted at the point
where ShellCheck expected the <code>fi</code>.</p>
<p>Check that the <code>if</code> statement is completely and correctly
terminated.</p>
<h3 id="exceptions">Exceptions:</h3>
<p>None</p>

    <title>ShellCheck: SC1048 – Can't have empty then clauses (use `true` as a no-op).</title>
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="css/bootstrap.min.css" />
  </head>
  <body style="margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto; max-width: 800px">
    <h1>SC1048 – ShellCheck Wiki</h1>
    <a href="https://github.com/koalaman/shellcheck/wiki/SC1048">See this page on GitHub</a>
    <p style="display: none"><a href="index.html">Sitemap</a></p>
    <hr />
    <h2 id="cant-have-empty-then-clauses-use-true-as-a-no-op">Can't have
empty then clauses (use <code>true</code> as a no-op).</h2>
<h3 id="problematic-code">Problematic code:</h3>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb1"><pre class="sourceCode sh"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb1-1"><a href="#cb1-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">if</span> <span class="bu">[</span> <span class="ot">-e</span> foo <span class="bu">]</span></span>
<span id="cb1-2"><a href="#cb1-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">then</span></span>
<span id="cb1-3"><a href="#cb1-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="co"># </span><span class="al">TODO</span><span class="co">: handle this</span></span>
<span id="cb1-4"><a href="#cb1-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">fi</span></span></code></pre></div>
<h3 id="correct-code">Correct code:</h3>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb2"><pre class="sourceCode sh"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb2-1"><a href="#cb2-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">if</span> <span class="bu">[</span> <span class="ot">-e</span> foo <span class="bu">]</span></span>
<span id="cb2-2"><a href="#cb2-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">then</span></span>
<span id="cb2-3"><a href="#cb2-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="co"># </span><span class="al">TODO</span><span class="co">: handle this</span></span>
<span id="cb2-4"><a href="#cb2-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="fu">true</span></span>
<span id="cb2-5"><a href="#cb2-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">fi</span></span>
<span id="cb2-6"><a href="#cb2-6" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb2-7"><a href="#cb2-7" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># Or use the no-op colon operator &quot;:&quot;</span></span>
<span id="cb2-8"><a href="#cb2-8" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">if</span> <span class="bu">[</span> <span class="ot">-e</span> foo <span class="bu">]</span></span>
<span id="cb2-9"><a href="#cb2-9" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">then</span></span>
<span id="cb2-10"><a href="#cb2-10" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="co"># </span><span class="al">TODO</span><span class="co">: handle this</span></span>
<span id="cb2-11"><a href="#cb2-11" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="bu">:</span></span>
<span id="cb2-12"><a href="#cb2-12" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">fi</span></span></code></pre></div>
<h3 id="rationale">Rationale:</h3>
<p>Shells do not allow empty <code>then</code> clauses. They need at
least one command (and comments are not commands).</p>
<p>If you want a <code>then</code> clause that does nothing, use a dummy
command like <code>true</code>.</p>
<h3 id="exceptions">Exceptions:</h3>
<p>None.</p>

    <hr />
    <h2 id="did-you-forget-the-then-for-this-if">Did you forget the
<code>then</code> for this <code>if</code>?</h2>
<h3 id="problematic-code">Problematic code:</h3>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb1"><pre class="sourceCode sh"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb1-1"><a href="#cb1-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">if</span> <span class="fu">true</span></span>
<span id="cb1-2"><a href="#cb1-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="bu">echo</span> <span class="st">&quot;foo&quot;</span></span>
<span id="cb1-3"><a href="#cb1-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">elif</span> <span class="fu">true</span></span>
<span id="cb1-4"><a href="#cb1-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="bu">echo</span> <span class="st">&quot;bar&quot;</span></span>
<span id="cb1-5"><a href="#cb1-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">fi</span></span></code></pre></div>
<h3 id="correct-code">Correct code:</h3>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb2"><pre class="sourceCode sh"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb2-1"><a href="#cb2-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">if</span> <span class="fu">true</span></span>
<span id="cb2-2"><a href="#cb2-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">then</span></span>
<span id="cb2-3"><a href="#cb2-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="bu">echo</span> <span class="st">&quot;foo&quot;</span></span>
<span id="cb2-4"><a href="#cb2-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">elif</span> <span class="fu">true</span></span>
<span id="cb2-5"><a href="#cb2-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">then</span></span>
<span id="cb2-6"><a href="#cb2-6" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="bu">echo</span> <span class="st">&quot;bar&quot;</span></span>
<span id="cb2-7"><a href="#cb2-7" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">fi</span></span></code></pre></div>
<h3 id="rationale">Rationale:</h3>
<p>ShellCheck found a parsing error in the script, and determined that
it's most likely due to a missing <code>then</code> keyword for the
<code>if</code> or <code>elif</code> indicated.</p>
<p>Make sure the <code>then</code> is there.</p>
<p>Note that the <code>then</code> needs a <code>;</code> or linefeed
before it. <code>if true then</code> is invalid, while
<code>if true; then</code> is correct.</p>
<h3 id="exceptions">Exceptions:</h3>
<p>None</p>
    <hr />
    <p style='font-size: 80%'><a href="https://www.shellcheck.net">ShellCheck</a> is a static analysis tool for shell scripts. This page is part of its documentation.</p>

<div class="sourceCode" id="cb1"><pre class="sourceCode sh"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb1-1"><a href="#cb1-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">if</span> <span class="fu">true</span><span class="kw">;</span> <span class="cf">then</span><span class="kw">;</span> <span class="bu">echo</span> <span class="st">&quot;Hi&quot;</span><span class="kw">;</span> <span class="cf">fi</span></span></code></pre></div>

    <link rel="stylesheet" href="css/bootstrap.min.css" />
  </head>
  <body style="margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto; max-width: 800px">
    <h1>SC1054 – ShellCheck Wiki</h1>
    <a href="https://github.com/koalaman/shellcheck/wiki/SC1054">See this page on GitHub</a>
    <p style="display: none"><a href="index.html">Sitemap</a></p>
    <hr />
    <h2 id="you-need-a-space-after-the-">You need a space after the
<code>{</code>.</h2>
<h3 id="problematic-code">Problematic code:</h3>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb1"><pre class="sourceCode sh"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb1-1"><a href="#cb1-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">foo()</span> <span class="ex">{echo</span> <span class="st">&quot;hello world&quot;</span><span class="kw">;</span> <span class="er">}</span></span></code></pre></div>
<h3 id="correct-code">Correct code:</h3>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb2"><pre class="sourceCode sh"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb2-1"><a href="#cb2-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">foo()</span> <span class="kw">{</span> <span class="bu">echo</span> <span class="st">&quot;hello world&quot;</span><span class="kw">;</span> <span class="kw">}</span></span></code></pre></div>
<h3 id="rationale">Rationale:</h3>
<p><code>{</code> is only recognized as the start of a command group
when it's a separate token.</p>
<p>If it's not a separate token, like in the problematic example, it
will be considered a literal character, as if writing
<code>"{echo"</code> with quotes, and therefore usually cause a syntax
error.</p>
<h3 id="exceptions">Exceptions:</h3>
<p>None.</p>
    <hr />
    <p style='font-size: 80%'><a href="https://www.shellcheck.net">ShellCheck</a> is a static analysis tool for shell scripts. This page is part of its documentation.</p>

<h3 id="problematic-code">Problematic code:</h3>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb1"><pre class="sourceCode sh"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb1-1"><a href="#cb1-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">submitbug()</span> <span class="kw">{</span></span>
<span id="cb1-2"><a href="#cb1-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="co"># </span><span class="al">TODO</span><span class="co">: Implement me</span></span>
<span id="cb1-3"><a href="#cb1-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="kw">}</span></span></code></pre></div>
<h3 id="correct-code">Correct code:</h3>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb2"><pre class="sourceCode sh"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb2-1"><a href="#cb2-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">submitbug()</span> <span class="kw">{</span></span>

<p>ShellCheck found an empty code block. This could be an empty function

<p>Sh/bash does not allow empty code blocks. Insert at least one
command. If you don't want the block to do anything, <code>true</code>
(aka <code>:</code>) is a good no-op.</p>

<h3 id="problematic-code">Problematic code:</h3>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb1"><pre class="sourceCode sh"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb1-1"><a href="#cb1-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">for</span> file <span class="kw">in</span> <span class="pp">*</span></span>
<span id="cb1-2"><a href="#cb1-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="bu">echo</span> <span class="st">&quot;</span><span class="va">$file</span><span class="st">&quot;</span></span>
<span id="cb1-3"><a href="#cb1-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">done</span></span></code></pre></div>
<h3 id="correct-code">Correct code:</h3>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb2"><pre class="sourceCode sh"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb2-1"><a href="#cb2-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">for</span> file <span class="kw">in</span> <span class="pp">*</span></span>
<span id="cb2-2"><a href="#cb2-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">do</span></span>
<span id="cb2-3"><a href="#cb2-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="bu">echo</span> <span class="st">&quot;</span><span class="va">$file</span><span class="st">&quot;</span></span>
<span id="cb2-4"><a href="#cb2-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">done</span></span></code></pre></div>
<h3 id="rationale">Rationale:</h3>
<p>ShellCheck has found a loop that appears to be missing a
<code>do</code> statement. In the problematic code, it was simply
forgotten.</p>
<p>Verify that the <code>do</code> exists, and that it's in the correct
place.</p>

    <h2
id="semicolon-is-not-allowed-directly-after-do-you-can-just-delete-it">Semicolon
is not allowed directly after <code>do</code>. You can just delete
it.</h2>
<h3 id="problematic-code">Problematic code:</h3>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb1"><pre class="sourceCode sh"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb1-1"><a href="#cb1-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">while</span> <span class="fu">true</span><span class="kw">;</span> <span class="cf">do</span><span class="kw">;</span> <span class="fu">true</span><span class="kw">;</span> <span class="cf">done</span></span>
<span id="cb1-2"><a href="#cb1-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb1-3"><a href="#cb1-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">while</span> <span class="fu">true</span><span class="kw">;</span></span>
<span id="cb1-4"><a href="#cb1-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">do</span><span class="kw">;</span></span>
<span id="cb1-5"><a href="#cb1-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="fu">true</span><span class="kw">;</span></span>
<span id="cb1-6"><a href="#cb1-6" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">done</span><span class="kw">;</span></span></code></pre></div>
<h3 id="correct-code">Correct code:</h3>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb2"><pre class="sourceCode sh"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb2-1"><a href="#cb2-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">while</span> <span class="fu">true</span><span class="kw">;</span> <span class="cf">do</span> <span class="fu">true</span><span class="kw">;</span> <span class="cf">done</span></span>
<span id="cb2-2"><a href="#cb2-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb2-3"><a href="#cb2-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">while</span> <span class="fu">true</span><span class="kw">;</span></span>
<span id="cb2-4"><a href="#cb2-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">do</span></span>
<span id="cb2-5"><a href="#cb2-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="fu">true</span><span class="kw">;</span></span>
<span id="cb2-6"><a href="#cb2-6" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">done</span><span class="kw">;</span></span></code></pre></div>
<h3 id="rationale">Rationale:</h3>
<p>Semicolon <code>;</code> is not allowed directly after a
<code>do</code> keyword. Follow it directly with either a command or a
linefeed as shown in the example.</p>
<h3 id="exceptions">Exceptions:</h3>
<p>None.</p>

    <title>ShellCheck: SC1063 – You need a line feed or semicolon before the `do`.</title>
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="css/bootstrap.min.css" />
  </head>
  <body style="margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto; max-width: 800px">
    <h1>SC1063 – ShellCheck Wiki</h1>
    <a href="https://github.com/koalaman/shellcheck/wiki/SC1063">See this page on GitHub</a>
    <p style="display: none"><a href="index.html">Sitemap</a></p>
    <hr />
    <h2 id="you-need-a-line-feed-or-semicolon-before-the-do">You need a line
feed or semicolon before the <code>do</code>.</h2>
<h3 id="problematic-code">Problematic code:</h3>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb1"><pre class="sourceCode sh"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb1-1"><a href="#cb1-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">for</span> file <span class="kw">in</span> <span class="pp">*</span> do</span>
<span id="cb1-2"><a href="#cb1-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="bu">echo</span> <span class="st">&quot;</span><span class="va">$file</span><span class="st">&quot;</span></span>
<span id="cb1-3"><a href="#cb1-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">done</span></span></code></pre></div>
<h3 id="correct-code">Correct code:</h3>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb2"><pre class="sourceCode sh"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb2-1"><a href="#cb2-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">for</span> file <span class="kw">in</span> <span class="pp">*</span><span class="kw">;</span> <span class="cf">do</span></span>
<span id="cb2-2"><a href="#cb2-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="bu">echo</span> <span class="st">&quot;</span><span class="va">$file</span><span class="st">&quot;</span></span>
<span id="cb2-3"><a href="#cb2-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">done</span></span>
<span id="cb2-4"><a href="#cb2-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb2-5"><a href="#cb2-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># or</span></span>
<span id="cb2-6"><a href="#cb2-6" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb2-7"><a href="#cb2-7" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">for</span> file <span class="kw">in</span> <span class="pp">*</span></span>
<span id="cb2-8"><a href="#cb2-8" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">do</span></span>
<span id="cb2-9"><a href="#cb2-9" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="bu">echo</span> <span class="st">&quot;</span><span class="va">$file</span><span class="st">&quot;</span></span>
<span id="cb2-10"><a href="#cb2-10" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">done</span></span></code></pre></div>
<h3 id="rationale">Rationale:</h3>
<p>ShellCheck found a <code>do</code> on the same line as a loop, but
<code>do</code> only starts a loop block at the start of a
line/statement. Make the <code>do</code> the start of a new
line/statement by inserting a linefeed or semicolon in front of it.</p>
<h3 id="exceptions">Exceptions:</h3>
<p>If you wanted to treat <code>do</code> as a literal string, you can
quote it to make this clear to ShellCheck and humans:</p>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb3"><pre class="sourceCode sh"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb3-1"><a href="#cb3-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">for</span> f <span class="kw">in</span> <span class="st">&quot;for&quot;</span> <span class="st">&quot;do&quot;</span> <span class="st">&quot;done&quot;</span></span>
<span id="cb3-2"><a href="#cb3-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">do</span></span>
<span id="cb3-3"><a href="#cb3-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="bu">echo</span> <span class="st">&quot;Shell keywords include: </span><span class="va">$f</span><span class="st">&quot;</span></span>
<span id="cb3-4"><a href="#cb3-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">done</span></span></code></pre></div>

    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, user-scalable=yes" />
    <title>ShellCheck: SC1064 – Expected a `{` to open the function definition.</title>
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="css/bootstrap.min.css" />
  </head>
  <body style="margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto; max-width: 800px">
    <h1>SC1064 – ShellCheck Wiki</h1>
    <a href="https://github.com/koalaman/shellcheck/wiki/SC1064">See this page on GitHub</a>
    <p style="display: none"><a href="index.html">Sitemap</a></p>
    <hr />
    <h2 id="expected-a--to-open-the-function-definition">Expected a
<code>{</code> to open the function definition.</h2>
<h3 id="problematic-code">Problematic code:</h3>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb1"><pre class="sourceCode sh"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb1-1"><a href="#cb1-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">foo()</span> <span class="kw">{</span></span>
<span id="cb1-2"><a href="#cb1-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="bu">echo</span> <span class="st">&quot;hello world&quot;</span></span>
<span id="cb1-3"><a href="#cb1-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="kw">}</span></span>
<span id="cb1-4"><a href="#cb1-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">foo()</span></span></code></pre></div>
<h3 id="correct-code">Correct code:</h3>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb2"><pre class="sourceCode sh"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb2-1"><a href="#cb2-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">foo()</span> <span class="kw">{</span></span>
<span id="cb2-2"><a href="#cb2-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="bu">echo</span> <span class="st">&quot;hello world&quot;</span></span>
<span id="cb2-3"><a href="#cb2-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="kw">}</span></span>
<span id="cb2-4"><a href="#cb2-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">foo</span></span></code></pre></div>
<h3 id="rationale">Rationale:</h3>
<p>ShellCheck found what appears to be the start of a function
definition, but without a function body.</p>
<p>One common cause is that you are trying to call a function by
appending parentheses, e.g. <code>foo()</code> like in C. Bash does not
use or allow parentheses after a function name to call it. The function
<code>foo</code> should be called using just <code>foo</code> like in
the example.</p>
<p>If you are declaring a function, make sure it looks like the correct
code above, and that it does not try to declare any parameters
(parameters are instead accessed with <code>$1</code> and up).</p>
<p>If you are trying to do something else, look up the syntax for what
you are trying to do.</p>
<h3 id="exceptions">Exceptions:</h3>
<p>POSIX allows the body of a function to be any compound command, e.g.
<code>foo() for i; do :; done</code>. Since this usage is rare,
ShellCheck intentionally requires the body to be <code>{ ..; }</code>
(or <code>( ..; )</code>):</p>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb3"><pre class="sourceCode sh"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb3-1"><a href="#cb3-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">foo()</span> <span class="kw">{</span></span>
<span id="cb3-2"><a href="#cb3-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="cf">for</span> i<span class="kw">;</span> <span class="cf">do</span> <span class="bu">:</span><span class="kw">;</span> <span class="cf">done</span></span>
<span id="cb3-3"><a href="#cb3-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="kw">}</span></span></code></pre></div>
<p>This additional structure requirement helps improve error messages
and suggestions by not parsing down a path that less advanced users
wouldn't expect.</p>
    <hr />
    <p style='font-size: 80%'><a href="https://www.shellcheck.net">ShellCheck</a> is a static analysis tool for shell scripts. This page is part of its documentation.</p>

    <title>ShellCheck: SC1065 – Trying to declare parameters? Don't. Use `()` and refer to params as `$1`, `$2`, …</title>
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="css/bootstrap.min.css" />
  </head>
  <body style="margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto; max-width: 800px">
    <h1>SC1065 – ShellCheck Wiki</h1>
    <a href="https://github.com/koalaman/shellcheck/wiki/SC1065">See this page on GitHub</a>
    <p style="display: none"><a href="index.html">Sitemap</a></p>
    <hr />
    <h2
id="trying-to-declare-parameters-dont-use--and-refer-to-params-as-1-2-">Trying
to declare parameters? Don't. Use <code>()</code> and refer to params as
<code>$1</code>, <code>$2</code>, …</h2>
<h3 id="problematic-code">Problematic code:</h3>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb1"><pre class="sourceCode sh"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb1-1"><a href="#cb1-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">foo</span><span class="er">(</span><span class="ex">input</span><span class="kw">)</span> <span class="kw">{</span></span>
<span id="cb1-2"><a href="#cb1-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="bu">echo</span> <span class="st">&quot;</span><span class="va">$input</span><span class="st">&quot;</span></span>
<span id="cb1-3"><a href="#cb1-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="kw">}</span></span>
<span id="cb1-4"><a href="#cb1-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">foo</span><span class="er">(</span><span class="st">&quot;hello world&quot;</span><span class="kw">);</span></span></code></pre></div>
<h3 id="correct-code">Correct code:</h3>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb2"><pre class="sourceCode sh"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb2-1"><a href="#cb2-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">foo()</span> <span class="kw">{</span></span>
<span id="cb2-2"><a href="#cb2-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="bu">echo</span> <span class="st">&quot;</span><span class="va">$1</span><span class="st">&quot;</span></span>
<span id="cb2-3"><a href="#cb2-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="kw">}</span></span>
<span id="cb2-4"><a href="#cb2-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">foo</span> <span class="st">&quot;hello world&quot;</span></span></code></pre></div>
<h3 id="rationale">Rationale:</h3>
<p>Shell script functions behave just like scripts and other
commands:</p>
<ul>
<li>They always take a 0 to N parameters, referred to with
<code>$1</code>, <code>$2</code> etc. They can not declare parameters by
name.</li>
<li>They are executed using <code>name arg1 arg2</code>, and not with
parentheses as C-like languages.</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="exceptions">Exceptions:</h3>
<p>None.</p>
    <hr />
    <p style='font-size: 80%'><a href="https://www.shellcheck.net">ShellCheck</a> is a static analysis tool for shell scripts. This page is part of its documentation.</p>
  </body>

    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, user-scalable=yes" />
    <title>ShellCheck: SC1066 – Don't use `$` on the left side of assignments.</title>
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="css/bootstrap.min.css" />
  </head>
  <body style="margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto; max-width: 800px">
    <h1>SC1066 – ShellCheck Wiki</h1>
    <a href="https://github.com/koalaman/shellcheck/wiki/SC1066">See this page on GitHub</a>
    <p style="display: none"><a href="index.html">Sitemap</a></p>
    <hr />
    <h2 id="dont-use--on-the-left-side-of-assignments">Don't use
<code>$</code> on the left side of assignments.</h2>
<h3 id="problematic-code">Problematic code:</h3>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb1"><pre class="sourceCode sh"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb1-1"><a href="#cb1-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="va">$greeting</span><span class="ex">=</span><span class="st">&quot;Hello World&quot;</span></span></code></pre></div>
<h3 id="correct-code">Correct code:</h3>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb2"><pre class="sourceCode sh"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb2-1"><a href="#cb2-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="va">greeting</span><span class="op">=</span><span class="st">&quot;Hello World&quot;</span></span></code></pre></div>
<p>Alternatively, if the goal was to assign to a variable whose name is
in another variable (indirection), use <code>declare</code>:</p>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb3"><pre class="sourceCode sh"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb3-1"><a href="#cb3-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="va">name</span><span class="op">=</span>foo</span>
<span id="cb3-2"><a href="#cb3-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="bu">declare</span> <span class="st">&quot;</span><span class="va">$name</span><span class="st">=hello world&quot;</span></span>
<span id="cb3-3"><a href="#cb3-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="bu">echo</span> <span class="st">&quot;</span><span class="va">$foo</span><span class="st">&quot;</span></span></code></pre></div>
<p>Or if you actually wanted to compare the value, use a test
expression:</p>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb4"><pre class="sourceCode sh"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb4-1"><a href="#cb4-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">if</span> <span class="bu">[</span> <span class="st">&quot;</span><span class="va">$greeting</span><span class="st">&quot;</span> <span class="ot">=</span> <span class="st">&quot;hello world&quot;</span> <span class="bu">]</span></span>
<span id="cb4-2"><a href="#cb4-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">then</span></span>
<span id="cb4-3"><a href="#cb4-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="bu">echo</span> <span class="st">&quot;Programmer, I presume?&quot;</span></span>
<span id="cb4-4"><a href="#cb4-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">fi</span></span></code></pre></div>
<h3 id="rationale">Rationale:</h3>
<p>Unlike Perl or PHP, <code>$</code> is not used when assigning to a
variable.</p>
<h3 id="exceptions">Exceptions</h3>
<p>None.</p>
    <hr />
    <p style='font-size: 80%'><a href="https://www.shellcheck.net">ShellCheck</a> is a static analysis tool for shell scripts. This page is part of its documentation.</p>

    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, user-scalable=yes" />
    <title>ShellCheck: SC1067 – For indirection, use arrays, `declare "var$n=value"`, or (for sh) `read`/`eval`</title>
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="css/bootstrap.min.css" />
  </head>
  <body style="margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto; max-width: 800px">
    <h1>SC1067 – ShellCheck Wiki</h1>
    <a href="https://github.com/koalaman/shellcheck/wiki/SC1067">See this page on GitHub</a>
    <p style="display: none"><a href="index.html">Sitemap</a></p>
    <hr />
    <h2
id="for-indirection-use-arrays-declare-varnvalue-or-for-sh-readeval">For
indirection, use arrays, <code>declare "var$n=value"</code>, or (for sh)
<code>read</code>/<code>eval</code></h2>
<p>Note: Removed in <a
href="https://github.com/koalaman/shellcheck/commit/fbb14d6b384a65ee16781966d9d240db9ed7b644">v0.7.2
- 2021-04-20</a></p>
<h3 id="problematic-code">Problematic code:</h3>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb1"><pre class="sourceCode sh"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb1-1"><a href="#cb1-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="va">n</span><span class="op">=</span>1</span>
<span id="cb1-2"><a href="#cb1-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">var</span><span class="va">$n</span><span class="ex">=</span><span class="st">&quot;hello&quot;</span></span></code></pre></div>
<h3 id="correct-code">Correct code:</h3>
<p>For integer indexing in ksh/bash, consider using an indexed
array:</p>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb2"><pre class="sourceCode sh"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb2-1"><a href="#cb2-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="va">n</span><span class="op">=</span>1</span>
<span id="cb2-2"><a href="#cb2-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="va">var</span><span class="op">[</span>n<span class="op">]=</span><span class="st">&quot;hello&quot;</span></span>
<span id="cb2-3"><a href="#cb2-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="bu">echo</span> <span class="st">&quot;</span><span class="va">${var</span><span class="op">[</span>n<span class="op">]</span><span class="va">}</span><span class="st">&quot;</span></span></code></pre></div>
<p>For string indexing in ksh/bash, use an associative array:</p>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb3"><pre class="sourceCode sh"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb3-1"><a href="#cb3-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="bu">typeset</span> <span class="at">-A</span> <span class="va">var</span></span>
<span id="cb3-2"><a href="#cb3-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="va">n</span><span class="op">=</span><span class="st">&quot;greeting&quot;</span></span>
<span id="cb3-3"><a href="#cb3-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="va">var</span><span class="op">[</span><span class="va">$n</span><span class="op">]=</span><span class="st">&quot;hello&quot;</span></span>
<span id="cb3-4"><a href="#cb3-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="bu">echo</span> <span class="st">&quot;</span><span class="va">${var</span><span class="op">[</span><span class="va">$n</span><span class="op">]</span><span class="va">}</span><span class="st">&quot;</span></span></code></pre></div>
<p>If you actually need a variable with the constructed name in bash,
use <code>declare</code>:</p>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb4"><pre class="sourceCode sh"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb4-1"><a href="#cb4-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="va">n</span><span class="op">=</span><span class="st">&quot;Foo&quot;</span></span>
<span id="cb4-2"><a href="#cb4-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="bu">declare</span> <span class="st">&quot;var</span><span class="va">$n</span><span class="st">=42&quot;</span></span>
<span id="cb4-3"><a href="#cb4-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="bu">echo</span> <span class="st">&quot;</span><span class="va">$varFoo</span><span class="st">&quot;</span></span></code></pre></div>
<p>For <code>sh</code>, with single line contents, consider
<code>read</code>:</p>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb5"><pre class="sourceCode sh"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb5-1"><a href="#cb5-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="va">n</span><span class="op">=</span><span class="st">&quot;Foo&quot;</span></span>
<span id="cb5-2"><a href="#cb5-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="bu">read</span> <span class="at">-r</span> <span class="st">&quot;var</span><span class="va">$n</span><span class="st">&quot;</span> <span class="op">&lt;&lt; EOF</span></span>
<span id="cb5-3"><a href="#cb5-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="st">hello</span></span>
<span id="cb5-4"><a href="#cb5-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="op">EOF</span></span>
<span id="cb5-5"><a href="#cb5-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="bu">echo</span> <span class="st">&quot;</span><span class="va">$varFoo</span><span class="st">&quot;</span></span></code></pre></div>
<p>or with careful escaping, <code>eval</code>:</p>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb6"><pre class="sourceCode sh"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb6-1"><a href="#cb6-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="va">n</span><span class="op">=</span>Foo</span>
<span id="cb6-2"><a href="#cb6-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="bu">eval</span> <span class="st">&quot;var</span><span class="va">$n</span><span class="st">=&#39;hello&#39;&quot;</span></span>
<span id="cb6-3"><a href="#cb6-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="bu">echo</span> <span class="st">&quot;</span><span class="va">$varFoo</span><span class="st">&quot;</span></span></code></pre></div>
<h3 id="rationale">Rationale:</h3>
<p><code>var$n=value</code> is not a valid way of assigning to a
dynamically created variable name in any shell. Please use one of the
other methods to assign to names via expanded strings. <a
href="https://mywiki.wooledge.org/BashFAQ/006">Wooledge BashFaq #6</a>
has significantly more information on the subject.</p>
<h3 id="exceptions">Exceptions:</h3>
<p>None</p>
<h3 id="related-resources">Related resources:</h3>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://mywiki.wooledge.org/BashFAQ/006">Wooledge BashFaq
#6</a>: How can I use variable variables (indirect variables, pointers,
references) or associative arrays?</li>
</ul>
    <hr />
    <p style='font-size: 80%'><a href="https://www.shellcheck.net">ShellCheck</a> is a static analysis tool for shell scripts. This page is part of its documentation.</p>

    <title>ShellCheck: SC1068 – Don't put spaces around the `=` in assignments.</title>
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="css/bootstrap.min.css" />
  </head>
  <body style="margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto; max-width: 800px">
    <h1>SC1068 – ShellCheck Wiki</h1>
    <a href="https://github.com/koalaman/shellcheck/wiki/SC1068">See this page on GitHub</a>
    <p style="display: none"><a href="index.html">Sitemap</a></p>
    <hr />
    <h1 id="dont-put-spaces-around-the--in-assignments">Don't put spaces
around the <code>=</code> in assignments.</h1>
<p>Note: Removed in <a
href="https://github.com/koalaman/shellcheck/commit/fbb14d6b384a65ee16781966d9d240db9ed7b644">v0.7.2
- 2021-04-20</a></p>
<h3 id="problematic-code">Problematic code:</h3>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb1"><pre class="sourceCode sh"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb1-1"><a href="#cb1-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">foo</span> = 42</span></code></pre></div>
<h3 id="correct-code">Correct code:</h3>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb2"><pre class="sourceCode sh"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb2-1"><a href="#cb2-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="va">foo</span><span class="op">=</span>42</span></code></pre></div>
<h3 id="rationale">Rationale:</h3>
<p>Shells are space sensitive. <code>foo=42</code> means to assign
<code>42</code> to the variable <code>foo</code>. <code>foo = 42</code>
means to run a command named <code>foo</code>, and pass <code>=</code>
as <code>$1</code> and <code>42</code> as <code>$2</code>.</p>
<h3 id="exceptions">Exceptions</h3>
<p>If you actually wanted to run a command named foo and provide
<code>=</code> as the first argument, simply quote it to make ShellCheck
be quiet: <code>foo "=" 42</code>.</p>
    <hr />
    <p style='font-size: 80%'><a href="https://www.shellcheck.net">ShellCheck</a> is a static analysis tool for shell scripts. This page is part of its documentation.</p>
  </body>
</html>

    <link rel="stylesheet" href="css/bootstrap.min.css" />

    <h1>SC1069 – ShellCheck Wiki</h1>

    <p style="display: none"><a href="index.html">Sitemap</a></p>
    <hr />
    <h2 id="you-need-a-space-before-the-">You need a space before the
<code>[</code>.</h2>
<h3 id="problematic-code">Problematic code:</h3>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb1"><pre class="sourceCode sh"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb1-1"><a href="#cb1-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="va">if</span><span class="op">[</span> -e file <span class="op">]</span></span>
<span id="cb1-2"><a href="#cb1-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">then</span> <span class="bu">echo</span> <span class="st">&quot;exists&quot;</span><span class="kw">;</span> <span class="cf">fi</span></span></code></pre></div>
<h3 id="correct-code">Correct code:</h3>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb2"><pre class="sourceCode sh"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb2-1"><a href="#cb2-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">if</span> <span class="bu">[</span> <span class="ot">-e</span> file <span class="bu">]</span></span>
<span id="cb2-2"><a href="#cb2-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">then</span> <span class="bu">echo</span> <span class="st">&quot;exists&quot;</span><span class="kw">;</span> <span class="cf">fi</span></span></code></pre></div>
<h3 id="rationale">Rationale:</h3>
<p>ShellCheck found a keyword immediately followed by a <code>[</code>.
There needs to be a space between them.</p>
<h3 id="exceptions">Exceptions:</h3>
<p>None</p>

    <title>ShellCheck: SC1071 – ShellCheck only supports sh/bash/dash/ksh scripts. Sorry!</title>
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="css/bootstrap.min.css" />
  </head>
  <body style="margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto; max-width: 800px">
    <h1>SC1071 – ShellCheck Wiki</h1>
    <a href="https://github.com/koalaman/shellcheck/wiki/SC1071">See this page on GitHub</a>
    <p style="display: none"><a href="index.html">Sitemap</a></p>
    <hr />
    <h2 id="shellcheck-only-supports-shbashdashksh-scripts-sorry">ShellCheck
only supports sh/bash/dash/ksh scripts. Sorry!</h2>
<h3 id="problematic-code">Problematic code:</h3>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb1"><pre class="sourceCode sh"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb1-1"><a href="#cb1-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co">#!/usr/bin/python</span></span>
<span id="cb1-2"><a href="#cb1-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">print</span> <span class="st">&quot;Hello&quot;</span></span></code></pre></div>
<h3 id="rationale">Rationale:</h3>
<p>You have specified the shebang of an unsupported language or shell
dialect.</p>
<p>ShellCheck only supports a limited number of Bourne-based Unix
shells: bash, ksh, dash and POSIX sh.</p>
<p>It does not support scripts written for other shells like Zsh, Csh,
Tcsh or PowerShell, and it does not support other scripting languages
like PHP, Python, JavaScript or SQL.</p>
    <hr />
    <p style='font-size: 80%'><a href="https://www.shellcheck.net">ShellCheck</a> is a static analysis tool for shell scripts. This page is part of its documentation.</p>
  </body>

  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, user-scalable=yes" />
    <title>ShellCheck: SC1072 – Unexpected ..</title>
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="css/bootstrap.min.css" />
  </head>
  <body style="margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto; max-width: 800px">
    <h1>SC1072 – ShellCheck Wiki</h1>
    <a href="https://github.com/koalaman/shellcheck/wiki/SC1072">See this page on GitHub</a>
    <p style="display: none"><a href="index.html">Sitemap</a></p>
    <hr />
    <h1 id="unexpected-">Unexpected ..</h1>
<p><em>Note: There is a <a href="../issues/1036">known bug</a> in the
current version when <a href="../wiki/Directive">directives</a> appear
within <code>then</code> clauses of <code>if</code> blocks that causes
Shellcheck to report SC1072 on otherwise valid code. Avoid using
directives within <code>then</code> clauses - instead place them at the
top of the <code>if</code> block or another enclosing block. This is
fixed on the <a href="https://www.shellcheck.net/">online version</a>
and the next release.</em></p>
<p>See <a
href="https://github.com/koalaman/shellcheck/wiki/Parser-Error">Parser
Error</a>.</p>
<p>This error can also occur with an <a
href="https://github.com/koalaman/shellcheck/wiki/Ignore/ceb874a8defc0df77b285e4fc54f897ed9dbb231#ignoring-all-errors-in-a-file-08">incomplete
shellcheck directive</a> like <code># shellcheck disable</code> instead
of <code># shellcheck disable=all</code>, or if the corresponding
command has been commented out.</p>
<h3 id="problematic-code">Problematic code</h3>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb1"><pre class="sourceCode sh"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb1-1"><a href="#cb1-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># shellcheck disable</span></span>
<span id="cb1-2"><a href="#cb1-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="bu">echo</span> stuff that shellcheck up to at least v0.10.0 will not even see because of the incorrect directive above</span></code></pre></div>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb2"><pre class="sourceCode sh"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb2-1"><a href="#cb2-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co">#shellcheck disable=SC2162</span></span>
<span id="cb2-2"><a href="#cb2-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co">#read VAR</span></span></code></pre></div>
<h3 id="correct-code">Correct code</h3>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb3"><pre class="sourceCode sh"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb3-1"><a href="#cb3-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># shellcheck disable=all</span></span>
<span id="cb3-2"><a href="#cb3-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="bu">echo</span> stuff that shellcheck will correctly ignore entirely</span></code></pre></div>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb4"><pre class="sourceCode sh"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb4-1"><a href="#cb4-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co">##shellcheck disable=SC2162</span></span>
<span id="cb4-2"><a href="#cb4-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co">#read VAR</span></span></code></pre></div>
    <hr />
    <p style='font-size: 80%'><a href="https://www.shellcheck.net">ShellCheck</a> is a static analysis tool for shell scripts. This page is part of its documentation.</p>

    <h2 id="did-you-forget-the--after-the-previous-case-item">Did you forget
the <code>;;</code> after the previous case item?</h2>
<h3 id="problematic-code">Problematic code:</h3>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb1"><pre
class="sourceCode bash"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb1-1"><a href="#cb1-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">while</span> <span class="ex">getoptions</span> f option</span>
<span id="cb1-2"><a href="#cb1-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">do</span></span>
<span id="cb1-3"><a href="#cb1-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="cf">case</span> <span class="st">&quot;</span><span class="va">${options}</span><span class="st">&quot;</span></span>
<span id="cb1-4"><a href="#cb1-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="kw">in</span></span>
<span id="cb1-5"><a href="#cb1-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="ss">f</span><span class="kw">)</span> <span class="va">FTR</span><span class="op">=</span><span class="st">&quot;</span><span class="va">${ARG}</span><span class="st">&quot;</span></span>
<span id="cb1-6"><a href="#cb1-6" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="ex">\?</span><span class="er">)</span> <span class="bu">exit</span></span>
<span id="cb1-7"><a href="#cb1-7" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="cf">esac</span></span>
<span id="cb1-8"><a href="#cb1-8" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">done</span></span></code></pre></div>
<h3 id="correct-code">Correct code:</h3>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb2"><pre
class="sourceCode bash"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb2-1"><a href="#cb2-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">while</span> <span class="ex">getoptions</span> f option</span>
<span id="cb2-2"><a href="#cb2-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">do</span></span>
<span id="cb2-3"><a href="#cb2-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="cf">case</span> <span class="st">&quot;</span><span class="va">${options}</span><span class="st">&quot;</span></span>
<span id="cb2-4"><a href="#cb2-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="kw">in</span></span>
<span id="cb2-5"><a href="#cb2-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="ss">f</span><span class="kw">)</span> <span class="va">FTR</span><span class="op">=</span><span class="st">&quot;</span><span class="va">${ARG}</span><span class="st">&quot;</span><span class="cf">;;</span></span>
<span id="cb2-6"><a href="#cb2-6" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="dt">\?</span><span class="kw">)</span> <span class="bu">exit</span><span class="cf">;;</span></span>
<span id="cb2-7"><a href="#cb2-7" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="cf">esac</span></span>
<span id="cb2-8"><a href="#cb2-8" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">done</span></span></code></pre></div>
<h3 id="rationale">Rationale:</h3>
<p>Syntax <code>case</code> needs <code>;;</code> after the previous
case item. If not, syntax error will cause.</p>

    <title>ShellCheck: SC1075 – Use `elif` instead of `else if`.</title>
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="css/bootstrap.min.css" />
  </head>
  <body style="margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto; max-width: 800px">
    <h1>SC1075 – ShellCheck Wiki</h1>
    <a href="https://github.com/koalaman/shellcheck/wiki/SC1075">See this page on GitHub</a>
    <p style="display: none"><a href="index.html">Sitemap</a></p>
    <hr />
    <h2 id="use-elif-instead-of-else-if">Use <code>elif</code> instead of
<code>else if</code>.</h2>
<h3 id="problematic-code">Problematic code:</h3>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb1"><pre class="sourceCode sh"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb1-1"><a href="#cb1-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">if</span> <span class="bu">[</span> <span class="st">&quot;</span><span class="va">$#</span><span class="st">&quot;</span> <span class="ot">-eq</span> 0 <span class="bu">]</span></span>
<span id="cb1-2"><a href="#cb1-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">then</span></span>
<span id="cb1-3"><a href="#cb1-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="bu">echo</span> <span class="st">&quot;Usage: ...&quot;</span></span>
<span id="cb1-4"><a href="#cb1-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">else</span> <span class="cf">if</span> <span class="bu">[</span> <span class="st">&quot;</span><span class="va">$#</span><span class="st">&quot;</span> <span class="ot">-lt</span> 2 <span class="bu">]</span></span>
<span id="cb1-5"><a href="#cb1-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">then</span></span>
<span id="cb1-6"><a href="#cb1-6" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="bu">echo</span> <span class="st">&quot;Missing operand&quot;</span></span>
<span id="cb1-7"><a href="#cb1-7" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">fi</span></span>
<span id="cb1-8"><a href="#cb1-8" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  </span></code></pre></div>
<h3 id="correct-code">Correct code:</h3>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb2"><pre class="sourceCode sh"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb2-1"><a href="#cb2-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">if</span> <span class="bu">[</span> <span class="st">&quot;</span><span class="va">$#</span><span class="st">&quot;</span> <span class="ot">-eq</span> 0 <span class="bu">]</span></span>
<span id="cb2-2"><a href="#cb2-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">then</span></span>
<span id="cb2-3"><a href="#cb2-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="bu">echo</span> <span class="st">&quot;Usage: ...&quot;</span></span>
<span id="cb2-4"><a href="#cb2-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">elif</span> <span class="bu">[</span> <span class="st">&quot;</span><span class="va">$#</span><span class="st">&quot;</span> <span class="ot">-lt</span> 2 <span class="bu">]</span></span>
<span id="cb2-5"><a href="#cb2-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">then</span></span>
<span id="cb2-6"><a href="#cb2-6" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="bu">echo</span> <span class="st">&quot;Missing operand&quot;</span></span>
<span id="cb2-7"><a href="#cb2-7" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">fi</span></span></code></pre></div>
<h3 id="rationale">Rationale:</h3>
<p>Many languages allow alternate branches with <code>else if</code>,
but <code>sh</code> is not one of them. Use <code>elif</code>
instead.</p>
<h3 id="exceptions">Exceptions:</h3>
<p><code>else if</code> is a valid (though confusing) way of nesting an
<code>if</code> statement in a parent's <code>else</code>. If this is
your intention, consider using canonical formatting by putting a
linefeed between <code>else</code> and <code>if</code>.</p>
<p>This does not change the behavior of the script, but merely makes it
more obvious to ShellCheck (and other humans) that you didn't expect the
<code>else if</code> to behave the way it does in C. Alternatively, you
can <a href="ignore">ignore</a> it with no ill effects.</p>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb3"><pre class="sourceCode sh"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb3-1"><a href="#cb3-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb3-2"><a href="#cb3-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">if</span> <span class="ex">x</span></span>
<span id="cb3-3"><a href="#cb3-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">then</span></span>
<span id="cb3-4"><a href="#cb3-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="bu">echo</span> <span class="st">&quot;x&quot;</span></span>
<span id="cb3-5"><a href="#cb3-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">else</span>     <span class="co"># line break here</span></span>
<span id="cb3-6"><a href="#cb3-6" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="cf">if</span> <span class="ex">y</span></span>
<span id="cb3-7"><a href="#cb3-7" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="cf">then</span></span>
<span id="cb3-8"><a href="#cb3-8" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="bu">echo</span> <span class="st">&quot;y&quot;</span></span>
<span id="cb3-9"><a href="#cb3-9" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>   <span class="cf">fi</span> </span>
<span id="cb3-10"><a href="#cb3-10" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">fi</span></span></code></pre></div>
    <hr />
    <p style='font-size: 80%'><a href="https://www.shellcheck.net">ShellCheck</a> is a static analysis tool for shell scripts. This page is part of its documentation.</p>

    <title>ShellCheck: SC1076 – Trying to do math? Use e.g. `[ $((i/2+7)) -ge 18 ]`.</title>
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="css/bootstrap.min.css" />
  </head>
  <body style="margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto; max-width: 800px">
    <h1>SC1076 – ShellCheck Wiki</h1>
    <a href="https://github.com/koalaman/shellcheck/wiki/SC1076">See this page on GitHub</a>
    <p style="display: none"><a href="index.html">Sitemap</a></p>
    <hr />
    <h2 id="trying-to-do-math-use-eg--i27--ge-18-">Trying to do math? Use
e.g. <code>[ $((i/2+7)) -ge 18 ]</code>.</h2>
<h3 id="problematic-code">Problematic code:</h3>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb1"><pre class="sourceCode sh"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb1-1"><a href="#cb1-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="bu">[</span> i / 2 <span class="er">+</span> <span class="ex">7</span> <span class="at">-ge</span> 18 ]</span></code></pre></div>
<h3 id="correct-code">Correct code:</h3>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb2"><pre class="sourceCode sh"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb2-1"><a href="#cb2-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="bu">[</span> <span class="va">$((i</span> <span class="op">/</span> <span class="dv">2</span> <span class="op">+</span> <span class="dv">7</span><span class="va">))</span> <span class="ot">-ge</span> 18 <span class="bu">]</span></span></code></pre></div>
<h3 id="rationale">Rationale:</h3>
<p>ShellCheck found a loose <code>+*/%</code> in a test statement. This
usually happens when trying to do arithmetic in a condition, but without
using the arithmetic expansion construct
<code>$((expression))</code>.</p>
<p>In C, <code>if (a+b == c)</code> is perfectly fine, but in sh this
must be written to first expand the arithmetic operation like
<code>if [ $((a+b)) = c ]</code>.</p>
<h3 id="exceptions">Exceptions:</h3>
<p>None.</p>
<h3 id="related-resources">Related resources:</h3>
<ul>
<li>Help by adding links to BashFAQ, StackOverflow, man pages, POSIX,
etc!</li>
</ul>

    <title>ShellCheck: SC1077 – For command expansion, the tick should slant left (`` ` `` vs `´`).</title>
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="css/bootstrap.min.css" />
  </head>
  <body style="margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto; max-width: 800px">
    <h1>SC1077 – ShellCheck Wiki</h1>
    <a href="https://github.com/koalaman/shellcheck/wiki/SC1077">See this page on GitHub</a>
    <p style="display: none"><a href="index.html">Sitemap</a></p>
    <hr />
    <h1 id="for-command-expansion-the-tick-should-slant-left--vs-">For
command expansion, the tick should slant left (<code>`</code> vs
<code>´</code>).</h1>
<h3 id="problematic-code">Problematic code:</h3>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb1"><pre class="sourceCode sh"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb1-1"><a href="#cb1-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="bu">echo</span> <span class="st">&quot;Your username is ´whoami´&quot;</span></span></code></pre></div>
<h3 id="correct-code">Correct code:</h3>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb2"><pre class="sourceCode sh"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb2-1"><a href="#cb2-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="bu">echo</span> <span class="st">&quot;Your username is </span><span class="va">$(</span><span class="fu">whoami</span><span class="va">)</span><span class="st">&quot;</span> <span class="co"># Preferred</span></span>
<span id="cb2-2"><a href="#cb2-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="bu">echo</span> <span class="st">&quot;Your username is </span><span class="kw">`</span><span class="fu">whoami</span><span class="kw">`</span><span class="st">&quot;</span>  <span class="co"># Deprecated, will give [SC2006]</span></span></code></pre></div>
<h3 id="rationale">Rationale:</h3>
<p>In some fonts it's hard to tell ticks apart, but Bash strongly
distinguishes between backticks (grave accent <code>`</code>), forward
ticks (acute accent <code>´</code>) and regular ticks (apostrophe
<code>'</code>).</p>
<p>Backticks start command expansions, while forward ticks are literal.
To help spot bugs, ShellCheck parses backticks and forward ticks
interchangeably.</p>
<h3 id="exceptions">Exceptions</h3>
<p>If you want to write out literal forward ticks, such as fancyful
ascii quotation marks:</p>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb3"><pre class="sourceCode sh"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb3-1"><a href="#cb3-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="bu">echo</span> <span class="st">&quot;</span><span class="kw">``</span><span class="st">Proprietary software is an injustice.´´  - Richard Stallman&quot;</span></span></code></pre></div>
<p>use single quotes instead:</p>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb4"><pre class="sourceCode sh"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb4-1"><a href="#cb4-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="bu">echo</span> <span class="st">&#39;``Proprietary software is an injustice.´´  - Richard Stallman&#39;</span></span></code></pre></div>
<p>To nest forward ticks in command expansion, use <code>$(..)</code>
instead of <code>`..`</code>.</p>
    <hr />
    <p style='font-size: 80%'><a href="https://www.shellcheck.net">ShellCheck</a> is a static analysis tool for shell scripts. This page is part of its documentation.</p>
  </body>
</html>

    <title>ShellCheck: SC1078 – Did you forget to close this double-quoted string?</title>
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="css/bootstrap.min.css" />
  </head>
  <body style="margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto; max-width: 800px">
    <h1>SC1078 – ShellCheck Wiki</h1>
    <a href="https://github.com/koalaman/shellcheck/wiki/SC1078">See this page on GitHub</a>
    <p style="display: none"><a href="index.html">Sitemap</a></p>
    <hr />
    <h1 id="did-you-forget-to-close-this-double-quoted-string">Did you
forget to close this double-quoted string?</h1>
<h3 id="problematic-code">Problematic code:</h3>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb1"><pre class="sourceCode sh"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb1-1"><a href="#cb1-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="va">greeting</span><span class="op">=</span><span class="st">&quot;hello</span></span>
<span id="cb1-2"><a href="#cb1-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="st">target=&quot;</span>world<span class="st">&quot;</span></span></code></pre></div>
<h3 id="correct-code">Correct code:</h3>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb2"><pre class="sourceCode sh"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb2-1"><a href="#cb2-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="va">greeting</span><span class="op">=</span><span class="st">&quot;hello&quot;</span></span>
<span id="cb2-2"><a href="#cb2-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="va">target</span><span class="op">=</span><span class="st">&quot;world&quot;</span></span></code></pre></div>
<h3 id="rationale">Rationale:</h3>
<p>The first line is missing a quote.</p>
<p>ShellCheck warns when it detects multi-line double quoted, single
quoted or backticked strings when the character that follows it looks
out of place (and gives a companion warning <a href="SC1079">SC1079</a>
at that spot).</p>
<h3 id="exceptions">Exceptions</h3>
<p>If you do want a multiline variable, just make sure the character
after it is a quote, space or line feed.</p>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb3"><pre class="sourceCode sh"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb3-1"><a href="#cb3-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="va">var</span><span class="op">=</span><span class="st">&#39;multiline</span></span>
<span id="cb3-2"><a href="#cb3-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="st">&#39;</span>value</span></code></pre></div>
<p>can be rewritten for readability and to remove the warning:</p>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb4"><pre class="sourceCode sh"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb4-1"><a href="#cb4-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="va">var</span><span class="op">=</span><span class="st">&#39;multiline</span></span>
<span id="cb4-2"><a href="#cb4-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="st">value&#39;</span></span></code></pre></div>
<p>As always <code>`..`</code> should be rewritten to
<code>$(..)</code>.</p>
    <hr />
    <p style='font-size: 80%'><a href="https://www.shellcheck.net">ShellCheck</a> is a static analysis tool for shell scripts. This page is part of its documentation.</p>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, user-scalable=yes" />
    <title>ShellCheck: SC1080 – You need `\` before line feeds to break lines in `[ ]`.</title>
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="css/bootstrap.min.css" />
  </head>
  <body style="margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto; max-width: 800px">
    <h1>SC1080 – ShellCheck Wiki</h1>
    <a href="https://github.com/koalaman/shellcheck/wiki/SC1080">See this page on GitHub</a>
    <p style="display: none"><a href="index.html">Sitemap</a></p>
    <hr />
    <h2 id="you-need--before-line-feeds-to-break-lines-in--">You need
<code>\</code> before line feeds to break lines in
<code>[ ]</code>.</h2>
<h3 id="problematic-code">Problematic code:</h3>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb1"><pre class="sourceCode sh"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb1-1"><a href="#cb1-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="bu">[</span> <span class="st">&quot;</span><span class="va">$filename</span><span class="st">&quot;</span> <span class="ot">=</span></span>
<span id="cb1-2"><a href="#cb1-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="st">&quot;</span><span class="va">$otherfile</span><span class="st">&quot;</span> <span class="bu">]</span></span></code></pre></div>
<h3 id="correct-code">Correct code:</h3>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb2"><pre class="sourceCode sh"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb2-1"><a href="#cb2-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="bu">[</span> <span class="st">&quot;</span><span class="va">$filename</span><span class="st">&quot;</span> <span class="ot">=</span> <span class="dt">\</span></span>
<span id="cb2-2"><a href="#cb2-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="er">&quot;$otherfile&quot;</span> <span class="ex">]</span></span></code></pre></div>
<h3 id="rationale">Rationale:</h3>
<p>Bash/ksh <code>[[ ]]]</code> can include line breaks anywhere, but
<code>[ ]</code> requires that you escape them. If you are writing a
multi-line <code>[ .. ]</code> statement, make sure to include these
escapes. If the <code>[ ]</code> is supposed to be on a single line,
make sure the <code>]</code> is there.</p>
<h3 id="exceptions">Exceptions:</h3>
<p>None</p>
<h3 id="related-resources">Related resources:</h3>
<ul>
<li>Help by adding links to BashFAQ, StackOverflow, man pages, POSIX,
etc!</li>
</ul>
    <hr />
    <p style='font-size: 80%'><a href="https://www.shellcheck.net">ShellCheck</a> is a static analysis tool for shell scripts. This page is part of its documentation.</p>
